author: Glass Reflection
description:
I thought I knew what "Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky" was. For its first six episodes, this university-set series felt like a quiet, deeply respectful romance. An anxious guy slowly being drawn out of his shell by a remarkably cheerful blind woman, treating her with genuine dignity while handling disability representation with care.

Then came... episode seven.

What started as a grounded exploration of personal agency and mutual connection suddenly whacked us in the face with a brutal plot twist. In this video, we break down why this pivot hurts so much: from the brilliant POV shifts and hidden Braille foreshadowing, to the tragic ghosting, the threat of falling into cheap "sad girl/manic pixie" tropes, and whether this show can pull off an ending that respects its characters' agency.
